origin.description: Stop in the browser at a chosen place in a pipe, then continue with the same value.
origin.details: This is a wrapper around browser. In batch R, debug_pipe(5) prints Called from: debug_pipe(5) and debug: x, then returns 5. browser reads the next source line as a command, so a timing script keeps the rest of the work inside one brace.

translation.description: Print the batch browser lines and return the same value.
translation.details: The two lines are Called from: followed by the call, and debug: x. For debug_pipe(5) those lines are Called from: debug_pipe(5) and debug: x. The value is returned unchanged.
